title: JSLH Grade 7 Term 2 Revision Bank — Batch Draft
status: development draft; partial coverage; not production-ready
sourceBasis: Original JSLH supplementary practice questions aligned with the Grade 7 2027 schemes of work. This batch is a first-pass coverage set, not a substitute for the full target of 80 MCQs and 120 structured questions per learning area.

learningAreas.name: Agriculture & Nutrition
mcq: Which practice helps reduce soil erosion on a sloping farm?
Contour terraces slow surface runoff and reduce soil loss.
Which planting material is commonly used to propagate cassava?
Cassava is commonly propagated vegetatively using stem cuttings.
Why should food handlers wash their hands before preparing food?
To reduce transfer of disease-causing microorganisms
Which is an example of reusing a household resource?
Using a clean jar to store dry food
A clean jar can serve another useful purpose, reducing waste.
Which nutrient is mainly needed for growth and repair of body tissues?
Proteins supply amino acids needed for growth and tissue repair.
structured: Explain three ways a farmer can conserve soil on a sloping piece of land.
Any three explained: terracing; contour farming; planting cover crops/grass strips; mulching; agroforestry; controlled grazing. One mark each.
State four safe practices to observe when preparing food at home.
Any four: wash hands; clean utensils and surfaces; use safe water; separate raw and cooked foods; cook thoroughly; cover food; store at safe temperatures. One mark each.

learningAreas.name: Creative Arts & Sports
mcq: Which element of art refers to the lightness or darkness of a colour?
Value describes how light or dark a colour appears.
A tint is made by mixing a colour with:
Adding white makes a colour lighter and produces a tint.
In a team game, why is communication important?
It helps players coordinate their actions
It prevents the need for practice
Players communicate to coordinate movement, passing and tactics.
Which item is suitable as a simple percussion instrument?
Ruler used as a drawing guide
A shaker produces sound when shaken and is a percussion instrument.
What should performers do before using a stage or performance space?
Checking the space helps identify hazards and prevent injuries.
structured: Describe four steps for preparing a simple visual-art composition.
Award one mark each for: select subject/theme; plan arrangement/sketch; choose suitable materials/colours; develop details and review/finish neatly.
Give four safety practices for learners taking part in a physical activity.
Any four: warm up; use suitable clothing/footwear; check playing area/equipment; follow rules; use correct technique; drink water/rest; cool down. One mark each.

learningAreas.name: CRE
mcq: In Christian teaching, forgiveness mainly involves:
Releasing resentment and being willing to reconcile
Forgiveness involves letting go of resentment; reconciliation may follow where appropriate.
Which action best demonstrates service to others?
Helping an elderly neighbour carry water
Helping a neighbour is a practical act of service.
Stewardship emphasises responsible care for creation.
Which value is shown by returning a lost item to its owner?
Returning property demonstrates honesty and respect for others.
A peaceful response to disagreement is to:
Listen respectfully and discuss the issue
Respectful dialogue helps resolve disagreements peacefully.
structured: Give four ways a Grade 7 learner can demonstrate Christian service in school or the community.
Any four explained: help vulnerable people; share resources; care for the sick; volunteer in community work; encourage others; protect public property; support classmates.
Explain three reasons Christians are encouraged to care for the environment.
Any three: creation is God's gift; protects life and health; conserves resources for future generations; expresses responsibility/stewardship; protects biodiversity. One mark each.

learningAreas.name: English
mcq: A direct question begins with a capital letter and ends with a question mark.
Identify the adjective in: 'The careful learner completed the task.'
Choose the correct verb: 'Each of the players ___ a water bottle.'
Each is singular, so it takes the singular verb has.
Which tense is used in: 'They visited the museum yesterday'?
Visited expresses an action completed in the past.
The main purpose of a formal letter is to:
Communicate an official message to a recipient
A formal letter communicates information or a request in an organised, respectful format.
structured: Rewrite correctly: 'the children was playing when it begin to rain.'
The children were playing when it began to rain. Award 1 for were, 1 for began, 1 for capitalisation and full stop.
State four features of a well-organised formal letter.

Any four: sender's address/date; recipient's address; appropriate salutation; clear subject/reference where appropriate; formal language; organised paragraphs; suitable closing; signature/name. One mark each.

learningAreas.name: Integrated Science
mcq: Heat transfer through a metal spoon placed in hot tea mainly occurs by:
Conduction transfers thermal energy through a material by particle interactions.
Which force opposes motion between two surfaces in contact?
Friction acts between surfaces in contact and opposes relative motion.
Which method can make river water safer before drinking at home?
Boiling kills many disease-causing microorganisms, although safe storage is still needed.
Which organ pumps blood around the human body?
The heart contracts to pump blood through the circulatory system.
Which of these is a renewable source of energy?
Sunlight is naturally replenished and is a renewable energy source.
structured: Describe how heat is transferred by conduction and give one everyday example.
Heat moves through a material from a hotter region to a cooler region by particle interactions (2); example such as a metal cooking spoon becoming hot (1).
State four ways learners can help protect water sources in their community.
Any four: avoid dumping waste; plant vegetation near water sources; use latrines properly; dispose chemicals safely; conserve water; report pollution; organise clean-ups. One mark each.

learningAreas.name: IRE
mcq: Which of the following is an obligatory daily prayer in Islam?
Fajr is one of the five obligatory daily prayers.
Wudhu is the prescribed minor ritual purification.
Which quality should a Muslim demonstrate when entrusted with another person's property?
Trustworthiness requires safeguarding what has been entrusted to someone.
Mark the end of a lesson
The Adhan announces that the time for an obligatory prayer has begun.
Which action is an example of sadaqah?
Sadaqah is voluntary charity and can include helpful acts.
structured: State four nullifiers of Wudhu as taught in basic Islamic practice.
Any four accepted syllabus-appropriate examples: passing urine; passing stool; passing wind; deep sleep/loss of consciousness. One mark each.
Explain three ways a Muslim learner can show good manners towards neighbours.
Any three: greet respectfully; assist when in need; avoid disturbing them; share appropriately; visit when suitable; protect their property; speak kindly. One mark each.

learningAreas.name: Kiswahili
mcq: Katika sentensi 'Mtoto mwerevu amefaulu', kivumishi ni kipi?
Mwerevu kinaeleza sifa ya nomino mtoto.
Jicho katika umoja huwa macho katika wingi.
Chagua sentensi iliyo katika wakati uliopita.
Kiambishi -li- huonyesha wakati uliopita katika walisoma.
Alama gani hutumika mwishoni mwa sentensi ya swali?
Alama ya kuuliza huonyesha kuwa sentensi ni swali.
structured: Andika sentensi tatu zinazoonyesha matumizi sahihi ya vivumishi.
Sentensi tatu sahihi zenye nomino na vivumishi vinavyopatana kisarufi: alama 1 kila sentensi.
Taja sifa nne za barua rasmi.
Anwani ya mwandishi; tarehe; anwani ya mpokeaji; salamu rasmi; kichwa/somo; lugha rasmi; hitimisho/sahihi. Alama 1 kila sifa nne.

learningAreas.name: Pre-Technical Studies
mcq: A triangular frame is commonly used in structures because it:
Provides rigidity and resists changing shape
Triangles form stable frames because their shape is resistant to distortion.
Which simple machine is a wheelbarrow an example of?
The load lies between the wheel (fulcrum) and the effort at the handles.
Which action helps protect a computer from electrical damage during a power interruption?
Pulling the power cable while running
A suitable uninterruptible power supply provides temporary backup and can help protect against abrupt outages.
Which material is usually attracted by a magnet?
Iron is a ferromagnetic material and is attracted by magnets.
Why should a learner smooth rough edges after cutting a workpiece?
To improve finish and reduce injury risk
Smoothing sharp edges improves finish and makes the item safer to handle.
structured: Describe four stages in making a simple model from a design brief.
Interpret the need/brief (1); sketch and plan (1); select materials/tools and measure/mark out (1); make, join, finish and evaluate (1).
Give four safe practices when using hand tools in a workshop.
Use the correct tool; inspect tools; secure the workpiece; wear appropriate protective equipment; keep workspace tidy; cut away from the body where appropriate; return tools safely. Any four.

learningAreas.name: Social Studies
mcq: Population density is calculated by dividing:
Population density is population divided by the area it occupies.
A rain gauge collects and measures the amount of precipitation.
A map key is used to:
Explain the symbols used on a map
Show the age of the map reader
The key or legend explains the meaning of map symbols.
Which action helps preserve cultural heritage?
Protecting historical sites and traditional knowledge
Protecting heritage sites and knowledge helps preserve them for future generations.
Which line of latitude divides Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres?
The Equator is at 0° latitude and separates the two hemispheres.
structured: Explain three factors that influence where people choose to settle.
Any three explained: water availability; fertile land; employment; transport/accessibility; security; climate; social services; relief. One mark each.
State four elements that should be included when preparing a simple map of a local area.
Title; key/legend; scale; north direction/orientation; clear symbols; labelled features. Any four, one mark each.
